ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Nonprofit Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and donors behind nonprofit organizations to identify potential fraud schemes.
questions: What are the most common types of nonprofit fraud?
How can donors protect themselves from fraudulent nonprofits?
ideas.insight: Nonprofit fraud can have devastating consequences for donors and the individuals or causes they support. By following the money, we can uncover potential fraud schemes and hold perpetrators accountable.
